decision.A: M3_VARIATION_NONLINEARLY_RECOVERABLE: R_sep >= 0.80 and FP <= 0.20 and CONS >= 0.80
decision.CONS: fraction of converged M3 trials (all truths) with chi2_err <= 13.8155
decision.FP: fraction of T0 trials with chi2_detect >= 13.8155
decision.R_sep: recovered fraction over T1 and T2 trials in LIN_SEP cells (all cells if fewer than 3 LIN_SEP)
decision.common_level_status: NOT_CLAIMED (KP1: common mode state-degenerate); the formal level error / sigma is reported as a consistency figure only
decision.consistency_status: CONSISTENT if CONS >= 0.9 and fraction(nees9 <= 27.877) >= 0.9; MARGINAL if both >= 0.7; else INCONSISTENT
decision.doppler_bias_impact: T1 at k = 0 on all 5 orbits re-solved with zero truth bias and NO bias parameters (D0); MATERIAL if median sigma_v(D1)/sigma_v(D0) >= 1.5 or the recovered count drops, else MINOR
decision.translation_contrast: recovered fraction in LIN_WEAK cells reported separately

estimator.a_priori: x0_ap = x0_true + N(0, diag(100 m, 0.1 m/s)^2), the same as the prior covariance; K start K0 for every segment; biases start 0; no prior on K or biases
estimator.covariance: QR of the column-normalised whitened design at the converged point; never a normal matrix inverse
estimator.kind: analysis-layer batch Gauss-Newton on production range and counted-Doppler VALUES and production Jacobians (D23-qualified path); production estimators have no counted-Doppler + range joint solve, per-pass bias or M3 K, and are not changed
estimator.parameters: x0 (6), K_1..K_3, one free constant bias per Doppler pass (CD1 D1)
estimator.staging: stage 1: x0 + biases with K held at K0 (<= 4 evaluations, 1e-2 sigma); stage 2: all parameters (<= 10 evaluations, converged when every Gauss-Newton step < 1e-2 sigma; the model evaluation carries ~1e-3 sigma integrator noise, measured in a simplified-dynamics smoke); step halving on cost increase; non-positive K candidates rejected without evaluation

forbidden: changing truths, amplitudes, priors, nuisance treatment, thresholds or cells after results

metrics.fit: whitened residual rms per measurement type
metrics.level: m = mean(f); level error / sigma reported; never claimed as identifiable
metrics.nees9: (x0, f) error against the 9x9 posterior block
metrics.variation: v = Q^T f, f = K_j / K0 - 1, Q orthonormal basis of the zero-mean subspace; chi2_err = (v_hat - v)^T C_v^-1 (v_hat - v); chi2_detect = v_hat^T C_v^-1 v_hat

model.K: M3_THREE_SEGMENT: K(t) = K_j on equal thirds of the 15-orbit arc (KP1 boundaries)
model.propagation: segmented production propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity, restart at boundaries, chained STM, exact per-segment dx/dK_j

population.cells: 5 orbits (CD1/KP1 set) x D3 epochs k in {0, 12}, HIGH_FIDELITY (primary)
population.linear_prediction: KP1 committed s_var_min (RPD_D1FREE, M3, HIGH_FIDELITY) per cell: LIN_SEP if >= 0.35 else LIN_WEAK
population.trials: one seed per (cell, truth): 30 primary M3 trials

question: Are the M3 variation directions that KP1 found locally distinguishable recoverable by a nonlinear batch estimator on production measurement VALUES under a free per-pass Doppler bias, without claiming the common K level?

truth.level: SYNTHETIC_CAMPAIGN_TRUTH, common level K0 = 0.01 m^2/kg in every truth
truth.noise: white, range 5 m, counted Doppler 1e-4 m/s (CD1 structural), seeded
truth.rationale: T0 = constant (false-detection control); T1, T2 = zero-mean 10 % variations spanning the 2-D variation subspace (variable effective area, GEO contract S1)

verification.d23: focused D23 regression in the full suite
verification.fd: segmented HF 2-orbit arcs (CANON k0, O2 k12) with the T1 nominal: perturb each K_j by +/- {1e-3, 3e-3} m^2/kg, repropagate segmented, central differences vs the chained dx/dK_j at every node; best-step relative error <= 1e-4
verification.kp1_anchor: at each T0 truth (constant K) the segmented design reproduces KP1 committed M3 sigma_frac and s_var_min for the cell (RPD_D1FREE, HF): relative difference <= 1e-5
verification.m0_baseline: scalar K on T0 at CANON k0 and O5 k0 (secondary): formal sigma vs CD1 committed sigma_k_frac_D1FREE within 5 %
verification.noise_free: CANON k0 HF, T1, zero noise and zero bias (biases still estimated): |f_hat - f| <= 0.02 sigma and |x0_hat - x0| <= 0.02 sigma (twice the convergence criterion)
verification.production_bls: CANON k0 HF, T0, range only, scalar K, no prior: KP2 solver vs production estimate_two_way_range_bls_lm(solve_for_k_srp=True) from the same start; every estimate difference <= 0.02 sigma (two convergence floors) and every sigma within 1 %
